explanation: No duplicate found. The statement is about `sheafMate`, which this library defines itself in SheafCohomology/ConePullback.lean. It says that this mate of a morphism of sheafed spaces is compatible with composition. A grep for `sheafMate` in Mathlib finds nothing. A grep for `pullbackCompInv` and `pullbackPushforwardAdjunction` finds only related results for sheaves of modules (in AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean) and for presheaves; it finds no `TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackCompInv`. So the content of the theorem rests on the library's own definitions. The proof only uses general mate and adjunction facts plus the library's own lemmas `sheafMate_adjoint` and `mateComp`, and it is not a short instance of any Mathlib declaration I found.
